digest.component_or_area: code-review gate per-pass model class resolution / plumbing
propositions: A single model knob (REBAR_LLM_MODEL) cannot express distinct per-pass model classes needed on non-default providers like Bedrock.
The code-review gate steps base, round_a, round_b and coach declare no per-step model class and implicitly inherit the run's single resolved cfg.model.
Batch steps must declare a single-rung model_ladder rather than a step-level model:, which is a silent no-op on the batch path.

A live inverted-config gate run shows every code-review step, including verify (model: standard), resolving to opus instead of the declared class, proving the runtime ignores per-step model declarations.
The plumbing defect is pre-existing and wider than this ticket, affecting 172e's verify declaration, tracked separately as blocking bug b690.
Per-pass models must resolve correctly per provider and be verified by an end-to-end test asserting the model each step actually receives at runtime.
